findings.issue: Server hydration ignores the configured Codex home.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: CLI composition owner must resolve and inject the configured home; no fix in AL-67.

findings.issue: Configured relative source paths resolve differently across commands.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: composition owner should preserve project anchoring and explicit CLI semantics.

findings.issue: Server advertises a live hook whose queries cannot read OpenCode v2.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: live composition owner should report unsupported capability; historical v2 hydration remains supported.

findings.issue: Duplicate Codex owner files can inflate combined cumulative facts.
findings.disposition: Confirmed by coordinator: grouping precedes unique-owner validation. Completion-phase co-discovery disputed impact; Codex adapter owner should reject ambiguous cumulative snapshots.

findings.issue: Live trace omits diagnostics when child lookup fails.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: live service/DTO owner should retain readable content and expose relationship availability; preserve unproven links as absent.

findings.issue: Caller cancellation does not reach expensive native source reads.
findings.disposition: Accepted debt: source adapter owner should propagate context through actual reads; runtime latency unmeasured.

findings.issue: Recovery and hydration retain divergent native storage selection.
findings.disposition: Accepted design debt: backfill/adapter owners should use narrow read capabilities and preserve operation-specific mixed-schema policy.

findings.issue: Source read completion does not define a common snapshot boundary.
findings.disposition: Recommendation: native read contract owner should specify per-owner guarantees and verify concurrent writers; no observed torn read.

findings.issue: Source families have different ordering guarantees for tied rows.
findings.disposition: Recommendation: adapter contract owner should define native sequence and deterministic tie behavior; no observed wrong anomaly.

findings.issue: Column-omission tests always reach the mixed-family rejection guard.
findings.disposition: Confirmed test limitation: future test owner should isolate schema families; current production column validation is not shown broken.

findings.issue: No-fallback test does not create a usable competing source.
findings.disposition: Confirmed coverage limit: future CLI test owner should supply an alternate fixture; no fallback defect found in code.

findings.issue: An oversized source repository would conflate distinct responsibilities.
findings.disposition: Design caution only: architecture owner should separate ledger persistence, source reads, discovery and observation.
